name: Cactus Apple
summary: In the Valley of Trials, Cactus Apples give orcs a rare source of moisture in Durotar’s dry heat.

sections.title: Desert Harvest
sections.body: Across the Valley of Trials, cactus apples grow in clusters around thick cactuses. Gathering them means working among the thorns, but the fruit eases the thirst of Durotar’s heat. Galgar, an orc in the valley, gathers the apples for Cactus Apple Surprise. Recruits enduring their early training can cool themselves with his treat.

faq.answer: Cactus apples grow wild in the Valley of Trials in southern Durotar. They cluster near the bases of stout cactus plants scattered across the basin.
Cactus Apple Surprise is a chilled dish Galgar prepares with freshly gathered cactus apples. The treat offers relief from Durotar’s desert heat.
Galgar, an orc in the Valley of Trials, asks young recruits to bring back six fresh apples. In return, he gives them portions of his cooling dessert.

angles.text: As a wilderness cook in Durotar, you can make a hydrating meal from desert cactuses.
As a young orc in Durotar, you learn to make use of every scarce bit of moisture the red canyon offers.
